_comment: What the ship's intercom says, by the moment it is for. Each line is a recording -- 'sound' names a folder under Assets/Audio, e.g. "Intercom/arrival_01" for Assets/Audio/Intercom/arrival_01/ -- and the subtitle shown while it plays; 'seconds' is how long the subtitle stays up (left out, worked out from its length). With several lines for a moment, one is chosen, the same one on every machine. Moments: course_set (the ship is leaving for somewhere), course_changed (a new destination part way), course_stopped (the course called off: coming to a stop), orbit (the ship has arrived over a planet or moon), region_found (the ship's scan has found somewhere new to go down), deploy (the shuttle is leaving the ship), arrival (the crew has landed), arrival_no_map (landed, and there was no map to give), power_out (somebody found the terminal has no power), download_started, download_done, launch (the shuttle's launch has been started), recovered and not_recovered (it has gone, with the data or without), left_behind (it has gone without you), docked (the shuttle is back in its bay), orders (a briefing has come in: for CIRRA's contracts, when they come). See Docs/RECORDING_AND_TEXTURES.md.

orders.subtitle: Attention all crew. New deployment orders have been received. Report to the briefing room.
